items.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: And I went up and he said, “Yeah we need a guitar player, you start Tuesday.”

ctx.x: And I went up and he said, “Yeah we need a guitar player, you start Tuesday.” So I went up and played and I was making $250 a week. It was a lot of money.
